title: Ejecutar frontier-pressure compiler contra un snapshot real de main
mission: Execute the persisted frontier-pressure compiler against an exact current main repository snapshot, persist the machine-readable result with source-head provenance, verify deterministic tests still pass on those bytes, and report the derived guide-pressure signals without promoting any product authority.
definition_of_done: An exact main commit SHA is pinned as the source snapshot.
scripts/compile-frontier-pressure.mjs executes against that repository snapshot using the current metabolism policy.
The resulting prometeo.frontier-pressure-snapshot/v1 JSON is persisted as durable evidence with observed_at and source head.
Existing frontier-pressure deterministic tests pass on the same source bytes or an exact failing boundary is recorded.
FRONTIER_THIN, RETURNS_UNCONSUMED and REPLACEABLE_PRESSURE are reported as derived canary signals only; no Current/Human Accepted/Served or production /w promotion is implied.
